title: Goodman Fielder Ltd - acquisition of Paradise Food Industries Pty Ltd

timeline.event: ACCC commenced review under the Merger Review Process Guidelines.
Closing date for submissions from interested parties.
ACCC announced it would not oppose the proposed acquisition.

body_sections.Summary: Goodman Fielder Ltd acquired Paradise Food Industries Pty Ltd.
body_sections.Market definition: The ACCC considered the acquisition in the context of national markets for the manufacture and supply of biscuits and salty/nutritious snacks.
body_sections.Competition analysis: On 19 May 2008, the ACCC formed the view that the acquisition was unlikely to substantially lessen competition in the relevant markets as there was a lack of overlap between the merger parties and no increase in market share, other than a transfer of market share.
